distribution.name: Listings.csv
distribution.description:
Airbnb is a popular online platform that enables people to rent out their homes, apartments, or rooms to travelers from all over the world. With millions of listings available in over 220 countries, Airbnb has become one of the largest and most widely-used accommodation platforms in the world.

This dataset provides a comprehensive collection of Airbnb listings data, including information about the hosts, the locations, and various scores about the experience of staying at each listing. The dataset is an essential resource for researchers, data scientists, and Airbnb hosts looking to gain insights into the characteristics of successful Airbnb listings, and to better understand the dynamics of the sharing economy.

The dataset contains detailed information about each listing, including its geographical location, the number of bedrooms, bathrooms, and amenities, and the reviews left by previous guests. Additionally, it includes information about the hosts, such as their profile description, response rate, and acceptance rate, which can provide valuable insights into the characteristics of successful Airbnb hosts.

With this dataset, researchers can explore a wide range of topics related to the sharing economy, including the impact of Airbnb on local housing markets, the factors that drive guest satisfaction, and the role of reputation in the sharing economy.

Overall, this Airbnb dataset is an invaluable resource for anyone interested in studying the rapidly-evolving landscape of online accommodation platforms.
